about_the_game:
Awaken in a Dystopian Prison
Step into the role of the only conscious being in a crumbling, AI-controlled mega-structure. In this gripping 3D action-adventure game, explore sprawling environments, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of a world ravaged by an ancient catastrophe.

Navigate twisting corridors, evade deadly traps, and outsmart the relentless AI matron who tracks your every move. Use stealth, cunning, and quick reflexes to survive her pursuit — because when she finds you, running might be your only option.

Will you escape and reclaim your freedom, or become another prisoner in this decaying machine?
